Inbound SMB lead from Fireflies partner channel. Interested in self-serve hosted API for call/meeting summarization and CRM enrichment. Short notes from calls:

- Compliance ask: SSO for console later, audit logs for deletions, retention controls per-customer. No VPC/on-prem required today.
- Quote: "If we can't guarantee data deletion or masking we can't sign — legal is strict on PII."
